description: This file defines a serializer (UriCodec) for the System.Uri type, including methods for reading and writing Uri values in a serialized form, as well as handling references. It also contains a copier class for Uri objects.

classes.name: UriCodec
classes.description: Serializer for System.Uri, implementing reading and writing logic for Uri objects in the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: UriCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier class for Uri objects, supporting derived-type copying within Orleans serialization.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Static method that reads a Uri value from the buffer, handling references and deserialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a Uri field to the buffer, handling references and serialization.
